s.zh: [DND边缘大陆] 传奇击杀传说：
\n眩晕、外力造成的精神状态、控制类状态、疼痛倒地：每次消耗 1 次，效果完全不生效。用完后控制正常生效。\n恢复满还要
s.en: \nStun, mental states caused by outside forces, control effects and pain downing: each use consumes 1, and the effect doesn't apply at all. Once spent, control applies normally.\nFully recovered in another

s.zh: \n15 格内的敌人每完成一次攻击，它就用掉传奇点做一个传奇动作（侦测、尾击、振翼……），不打断自己的攻击。每 4 秒恢复 1 点。
s.en: \nEach time an enemy within 15 cells completes an attack, it spends legendary points on a legendary action (detect, tail attack, wing attack...) without interrupting its own attack. Recovers 1 point every 4 seconds.
